title: End-to-End KYC Remediation with Datakeen
summary: Accelerate KYC remediation with AI-powered document intelligence that reduces customer friction and strengthens compliance.
body_markdown:
## Turn compliance complexity into a smarter customer experience.


Concentrix and Datakeen help financial institutions harness the value held in their document repositories. AI-enabled document intelligence identifies and extracts relevant customer information before a remediation campaign begins.


Our approach to KYC remediation starts with the evidence you already have. Existing records are evaluated against current requirements, allowing compliant files to move forward without unnecessary outreach. This reduces operational costs while easing the burden on customers and compliance teams.


When more information is required, personalized communications and secure digital submission journeys make it easier for customers to respond. Automated verification works alongside experienced compliance specialists to support sound decisions at scale.


Bring greater visibility and confidence to every stage of KYC remediation. Transform unstructured documents into usable compliance data, accelerate progress, and build trust through a targeted process designed for evolving regulatory demands.


Download our solution sheet to learn more.
